_comment: Single source of truth for artifact-suppression constraint snippets (the model-facing text) + the default selection. Imported by frontend/src/lib/constraintPresets.ts AND read by backend/constraints.py so the web UI and the headless CLI can never drift. UI-only metadata (label/hint) lives in constraintPresets.ts.

categories.sharpness: sharp focus, crisp fine detail, no motion blur
categories.noise: clean signal, no grain, no sensor noise
categories.compression: high fidelity, no compression artifacts, no jpeg blocking
categories.color: accurate natural color, no chromatic aberration, no color banding
categories.anatomy: correct anatomy, well-formed hands, natural proportions
